extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news:
1.0.82: Add MKGA playback branding for free accounts, independent of subtitles. Stremio for Kodi remains free; voluntary supporter contributions help fund development, maintenance and new features. Supporters receive playback without the watermark. Add release notes with Update / Cancel for future updates. Older versions keep their previous behavior; disable Kodi automatic addon updates to stay on an older version.\n\n1.0.80: Add explicit Raspberry Pi 3 couch-test confirmation to the privacy-safe low-power benchmark report; MKGA review remains required before issue closure.\n\n1.0.79: Add Support → Run low-power benchmark and a repeatable Raspberry Pi 3 performance pass; issue #47 remains open until real Pi 3 evidence is reviewed.
1.0.78: Preserve rich Cast/Crew photos and roles from metadata providers, show stream Audio/Language details without emoji glyph dependency, and keep sidebar label sizing consistent.
1.0.77: Keep the original embedded subtitle active when optional AI translation fails, while preserving a private diagnostic for Support.
1.0.76: Make Home infinite scrolling work even on Kodi/Fire TV builds that consume horizontal D-pad actions internally; lazy loading remains 16 items per page.
1.0.75: Make Settings focus unambiguous: inactive selected rows stay dim, while the bright highlight appears only in the column that currently has D-pad focus.
1.0.74: Refresh Continue Watching and episode watched state immediately after confirmed playback sync, without waiting for the maintenance interval.
1.0.73: Let full-episode BYOK subtitle translations finish by scaling the request timeout to subtitle size, up to 90 seconds. Short translations keep the existing 15-second timeout.
1.0.72: Keep confirmed Exit closed, return to Kodi Home after Exit dialogs close, and ignore queued reopen requests for three seconds after Exit. Cancel remains available.
1.0.71: Honor the MKGA.TV Auto translate preference for both cloud and BYOK playback paths, keep original subtitles when translation is off, and handle empty embedded-only subtitle results safely.
1.0.70: Restore the proven two-press Back/Exit guard.
1.0.62: Faster Home refresh with cursor-safe infinite catalogs, incremental row patching, and background-only account/library/CW maintenance.
1.0.61: Add stale-while-revalidate Streams SQLite v2 and idle Continue Watching stream prefetch for faster source opening.
1.0.60: Fix Stremio 1ms next-episode pointers and avoid false finished-series state when metadata is incomplete.
1.0.59: Fix Continue Watching regression: remove watched/90%+ movies, keep completed series hidden until an aired next episode is verified, and rebuild the SQLite CW index automatically.
1.0.58: SQLite-backed Continue Watching for all series, MKGA server-side subtitle resolver/cloud cache, Noiro-style fast subtitle translation path, and Kodi API networking fixes.
1.0.57: Remove Premium UI, add MKGA subtitle sync status/Sync Now, and support Orange subtitle color from MKGA.TV.
1.0.56: Make MKGA.TV Account the recommended subtitle settings source while preserving a full This device - Local fallback and keeping Gemini keys local.
1.0.55: Sync MKGA.TV subtitle preferences in the background, including language priority, AI behavior and Kodi subtitle style.
1.0.51: Prevent legacy-profile migration failures from blocking startup/sign-in, and add an optional native Kodi Search keyboard for Yatse/Kore and physical/Bluetooth keyboard users.
